items.title: 腾讯控股今日盘后发布2026年Q2财报，预期营收约2038亿、AI资本开支为核心变量
items.summary: 腾讯将于港股收市后公布Q2 2026业绩，市场一致预期营收同比增9%–14%至约2016–2111亿元，非国际准则净利润约666亿元。核心关注：1）AI资本开支规模是否冲破2000亿并压制利润率；2）元宝/混元AI应用商业化进展；3）广告（AIM+）与游戏增速指引。
items.why: 核心持仓赛道股，今日财报驱动股价短期最大不确定性；盘后若实际数字或指引超预期，可评估次日卖 sell put 机会；低于预期则需审视行权价安全边际。

items.title: US July CPI Due Tonight (8:30 AM ET); Economists Forecast 3.4% YoY — Key for Fed September Decision
items.summary: BLS releases July 2026 CPI at 8:30 AM ET (20:30 Beijing). Consensus: headline +3.4% YoY (vs +3.5% in June), core flat MoM / +2.6% YoY. A print in-line or softer would reinforce the case for the Fed to hold rates at the September 16 meeting; a surprise beat would revive hike fears.
items.why: 美国7月CPI今晚公布，是本轮宏观数据的核心锚点，直接影响美联储9月加息概率，进而影响所有美股成长股估值及期权隐含波动率方向。

items.title: Hormuz Deadlock Hardens: Iran Demands Sanctions Relief & War Reparations; Brent Near $84, US Stocks Slip
items.summary: Iran's FM Araghchi said Monday talks with Oman are 'close' but Washington must ease sanctions and pay war reparations before any reopening. Trump stopped short of a military strike but deal prospects faded; Brent crude held near $84/barrel. US stocks slipped Tuesday as the Iran impasse intensified ahead of the CPI print.
items.why: 霍尔木兹谈判再次僵化，油价维持高位，通胀预期受压，压制美股科技估值（Nasdaq -0.6% 8月11日）。与 CPI 数据形成双重宏观压力节点，今日关注 CPI 数据能否驱动预期转向。

items.title: 英伟达联合华尔街资管巨头承诺逾5000亿美元AI基础设施投资
items.summary: 英伟达与Apollo、BlackRock等华尔街资管巨头宣布共同出资逾5000亿美元用于AI基础设施，涵盖数据中心、能源及融资安排；黄仁勋表示AI算力正成为可投资资产类别，将改变资本市场格局。
items.why: 机构资金以空前规模绑定AI算力基础设施，强化英伟达在AI硬件供应链的核心地位；对持仓中的英伟达、SK海力士、美光等AI算力链标的构成中长期利好，可作为逢低布局或sell put的参考背景。

items.title: 霍尔木兹海峡局势升温，国际油价单日涨逾4%
items.summary: 中东紧张态势持续，霍尔木兹海峡断航风险上升，布伦特原油及WTI原油期货当日涨幅均超4%，能源股受提振，对通胀预期形成新压力。
items.why: 地缘风险溢价推高油价将放大全球通胀预期，可能延后美联储降息路径，对港股/A股及美股风险资产估值形成压制；持有期权仓位需留意隐含波动率随地缘风险上行。

items.title: 【今日】腾讯控股Q2 2026财报前瞻：资本开支或超2000亿为核心风险，AI指引是关键
items.summary: 市场预期腾讯Q2营收约2016–2111亿元（同比+9%–14%），非国际准则净利润约660亿（+5%–6%）。关注点：①AI资本开支规模可能冲击2000亿压制利润；②微信视频号/元宝广告变现；③混元大模型商业化指引。事件今日盘后实际发布。
items.why: 核心持仓腾讯即将公布财报，游戏及广告收入增速是股价短期最大变量；若sell put行权价临近财报窗口，需评估隐含波动率上升后的保证金及行权风险。

items.title: US July 2026 Nonfarm Payrolls −23K vs +83K Est; Fed September Hike Odds Fall to 44%
items.summary: July nonfarm payrolls fell 23,000 (vs. +83,000 consensus). Prior months revised down 103,000 combined. Unemployment 4.1%. S&P 500 hit record 7,757.64. September Fed rate hike probability fell from 57% to 44%. Markets now price three cuts through year-end.
items.why: 7月非农大幅转负压低加息预期，带动美股S&P 500创历史纪录；全球风险情绪改善利好港股科技持仓；结合今日CPI数据，判断加息路径是否进一步转变。

items.title: Memory Chip Rout: Western Digital −16%, SanDisk −11%, Micron −6% on Weak Guidance; KOSPI Sidecar Triggered
items.summary: SanDisk and Western Digital posted strong fiscal Q4 results but guided Q1 FY27 revenue below consensus, triggering a sector selloff. Western Digital slid ~16%, SanDisk ~11%, Micron ~6%, SK Hynix fell over 9% in Korea, and South Korea's KOSPI activated a sidecar circuit breaker.
items.why: 直接影响持仓 SNDK、MU、SK海力士：存储周期短期进入调整预期，但行业2027年产能已售罄的基本面并未改变；本周须关注三星HBM4良率80%对 SK海力士 竞争格局的影响及 HBM4 劳资风险。

items.title: S&P 500 Hits Record 7,757.64 After Weak Jobs Report; Nasdaq +1.3%, September Hike Odds Slump
items.summary: US stocks surged to record highs on Aug 7 as weak July payrolls (−23K vs +83K est.) slashed Fed rate-hike odds. S&P 500 closed at record 7,757.64 (+0.62%); Nasdaq rose 1.3% to 26,690.62. September hike probability fell from 57% to 44%.
items.why: 美股历史新高叠加加息预期回落，利多全球风险资产估值；港股科技持仓可受益，今日 CPI 数据是决定这一趋势能否延续的关键节点。

items.title: Google Shakes Up AI Leadership: Hassabis Moves to Chairman, Jeff Dean Exits; GOOGL −5% on $190B Market Cap Wipe
items.summary: DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis moves to chairman role; CTO Kavukcuoglu takes over daily ops. 27-year veteran Jeff Dean departed to launch Discovery Loop. GOOGL fell ~5% as Gemini flagship missed June launch deadline, sparking concerns Google is falling behind OpenAI and Anthropic.
items.why: GOOGL是持仓标的；核心AI研究团队在关键竞争节点震荡，Gemini 4路线图尚未确认；持有GOOGL者需持续关注AI竞争力与产品进展，期权侧关注隐含波动率是否继续上行。

items.title: 港股午评：恒指跌1.17%报25352点，科网股普跌（阿里跌超3%），光通信板块逆势领涨
items.summary: 8月12日午间收盘，恒生指数跌1.17%至25352.13点，恒生科技指数跌1.17%，国企指数跌1.27%。科网股普跌：哔哩哔哩、网易、阿里巴巴跌超3%；光通信板块强势，中际旭创涨超7%；云计算板块跌幅居前，金蝶国际跌超7%；创新药板块走弱。
items.why: 持仓核心港股科网（腾讯、阿里）今日均承压，上午盘跌幅较大；腾讯Q2财报今日盘后发布，正股午盘表现反映市场情绪偏谨慎；光通信强势与前期 FCC 管控预期形成博弈，值得关注中际旭创等后续走势。

items.title: 腾讯音乐Q2 2026实际业绩：营收89.3亿元同比增5.8%，喜马拉雅整合贡献4.07亿
items.summary: 腾讯音乐娱乐(TME)公布Q2 2026未经审核财报：总营收人民币89.3亿元（同比+5.8%），其中在线音乐服务收入76.1亿元（同比+11%），付费会员收入47.9亿元（同比+8.1%）；本季起首度并入喜马拉雅收入4.07亿元。非国际准则净利润26.9亿元。
items.why: 腾讯音乐是腾讯增值服务生态的前导指标，Q2付费用户和收入双增预示腾讯音乐+音频生态健康；为今日腾讯控股Q2财报（增值服务板块）提供正向参照，情绪辅助信号。

items.title: Intel Sells $15B in New Stock to Fund AI Foundry Expansion; ~3% Dilution for Returns Not Due Until 2028
items.summary: Intel launched a $15 billion equity offering on Aug 10, diluting existing shareholders by roughly 3%. Proceeds earmarked for AI foundry expansion (18A process, Intel Foundry) and general corporate purposes. Analysts note the foundry turnaround timeline runs to 2028, while no external foundry customer has yet been signed at scale.
items.why: 英特尔$150亿增发稀释约3%，持股者短期受压；代工业务重押18A工艺，2028年才能产生回报且客户尚未落地，执行风险大；可关注 INTC 期权隐含波动率是否因增发重新定价。

items.title: Palantir Bull Case Hardens After 'Otherworldly' Q2; BofA Raises Target to $255; PLTR +39% Past Week at $175
items.summary: Palantir Q2 2026: revenue $1.94B (+93% YoY), adj. EPS $0.41 (+24% beat). US commercial revenue +149% to $764M; FY 2026 guidance raised to $8.15–8.16B (+82% YoY). Bank of America reiterated Buy, raised PT to $255 (50% upside). PLTR has surged ~39% from pre-earnings close, trading at ~$175 on Aug 11.
items.why: Palantir Q2业绩远超预期，US商业端两年涨380%；机构持续上调目标价；对 PLTR sell put 策略：股价大幅上涨后可考虑上调行权价或卖出 covered call，同时注意高估值下的回调风险。

items.title: Alibaba to Report June Quarter FY2027 Results on August 20 — Key AI Cloud Focus
items.summary: Alibaba Group will report unaudited results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 before US market open on August 20. Analysts will focus on cloud revenue growth trajectory (+38% prior quarter) and Qwen3.8-Max global deployment impact. Stock has rallied ~39% from June lows.
items.why: 阿里8月20日（8天后）财报为重要催化剂；Qwen AI与云收入增速是市场核心关注；股价从低点已涨39%积累浮盈，财报前可评估是否卖 covered call；同日富途(FUTU)亦发报，市场情绪集中释放。

items.title: SK Hynix Labor Talks Stall Over Stock-Based Bonus Dispute; Samsung HBM4 Yield Hits 80%
items.summary: SK Hynix's fifth round of 2026 wage talks broke down after management proposed paying annual bonuses partly in company stock (rejected by the union). Simultaneously, Samsung's HBM4 yield reportedly reached 80%, intensifying competitive pressure on SK Hynix's AI memory dominance.
items.why: SK海力士劳资纠纷若升级为怠工/罢工，将直接威胁HBM4产能，加重Nvidia Vera Rubin平台供应不确定性；三星HBM4 80%良率意味着竞争白热化。7709.HK南方两倍做多ETF需关注下行风险，sell put 执行价宜保守。

items.title: Disney Q3 FY2026: Streaming Profit Doubles to $712M; Parks +10%; Adj. EPS $2.06 Beats by 11%
items.summary: Disney reported fiscal Q3 2026 (ended June 27): adj. EPS $2.06 (beat $1.86 est. by 11%), revenue +7% to $25.2B. Entertainment streaming operating income more than doubled to $712M. Experiences revenue +10% to ~$10B. Toy Story 5 surpassed $1B at global box office. TikTok global content deal announced.
items.why: 迪士尼流媒体利润翻倍超预期，乐园业务强劲；中长期持有 DIS 逻辑持续兑现；covered call 持有者可关注行权价策略。

items.title: Circle (CRCL) Q2 2026: USDC Volume +151%; Revenue $701M; OCC Federal Bank Charter Granted July 8
items.summary: Circle Q2 2026: revenue $701M (+7% QoQ); USDC circulating supply $73.3B (+38% YoY); on-chain transaction volume +151% YoY; full-year revenue guidance raised to $2.85–2.95B. Circle received OCC national trust bank approval July 8, becoming first stablecoin issuer with federal banking charter. Morgan Stanley downgraded to Underweight, PT cut to $38 from $106 (Aug 3).
items.why: OCC联邦银行牌照是稳定币赛道监管里程碑，Circle商业模式获政策背书；但MS大幅下调目标价至$38，估值分歧巨大；对持有 CRCL 的中长期投资者，关注 Arc 产品路线及稳定币法案(GENIUS Act)进展。

items.title: FCC Drafts Ban on New Chinese Optical Modules for US AI Data Centers; Chinese Firms Hold 60%+ of 800G+ Market
items.summary: The U.S. FCC is drafting rules to bar imports of new-model Chinese optical transceivers for AI data centers. Chinese manufacturers including Innolight and Eoptolink hold over 60% of global high-bandwidth (800G+) optical module supply. A ban could cut 60% of AI data center optical supply.
items.why: 延续报道：FCC光模块管控草案持续压制A股中际旭创、华工科技等（今日港股光通信板块逆势+7%，博弈管控预期落空预期）；美国数据中心短期供应缺口对英伟达算力扩张形成制约。

items.title: SpaceX to Build On-Site Gas Plants for Terafab Chip Factory — Tesla-SpaceX Joint AI Chip Project Advances
items.summary: SpaceX plans natural gas-fired power plants and battery storage for the Terafab chip factory being co-developed with Tesla in Grimes County, Texas. The facility will produce chips for Optimus robots, Cybercabs, and SpaceX data centers, with the project flagging at least $55B in total investment.
items.why: Terafab自建供电设施标志项目实质推进，将Tesla/SpaceX定位从汽车+火箭升维为AI芯片+机器人综合体；但Jefferies已下调Tesla 2026 EBIT预测37%，短期基本面压力大。持有TSLA期权卖方需警惕事件驱动波动。

items.title: Gold Jumps 2.4% to $4,353/oz on Weak Jobs Data — Best Week Since January; 老铺黄金 Catalyst
items.summary: Spot gold surged $102 to $4,353/oz (+2.41%) on Aug 7, a seven-week high, after July payrolls badly missed expectations and erased Fed rate-hike bets. Gold posted its best weekly performance since January 2026.
items.why: 金价大涨直接利好老铺黄金（6181.HK）——金价上行扩大古法金产品利润率；金价高位也支撑蜜雪冰城等消费类股整体情绪；若金价维持高位，可考虑老铺 Covered Call 行权价上移。

items.title: Futu Holdings (FUTU) to Report Q2 2026 Results on August 20 Before Market Open
items.summary: Futu Holdings will release Q2 2026 financial results on August 20, before the US market opens, followed by a management call at 8:00 AM ET. Analysts will focus on new account openings, paid clients, and moomoo's overseas expansion.
items.why: 富途8月20日财报为近期催化剂；同日阿里巴巴亦发布财报，市场情绪集中释放，需关注港美股券商板块波动率变化；moomoo国际化进展是核心跟踪指标。

items.title: McDonald's Q2 2026: China Comparable Sales Turn Negative; EPS $3.38 Beats Narrowly
items.summary: McDonald's reported Q2 2026 adj. EPS $3.38 (beat $3.34 est.); global first-half revenue +6%. U.S. same-store sales +0.8%. Management explicitly flagged negative comparable sales in China due to intense competition, while remaining on track to open ~1,000 new China restaurants in 2026.
items.why: 麦当劳中国可比销售明确转负，映射中国餐饮竞争激烈程度；对中国消费赛道持仓（海底捞6862.HK、蜜雪冰城2097.HK）有参考意义——外资快餐承压说明国内消费者议价能力上升，定价权受压。

items.title: Costco Reports July 2026 Net Sales $23.12B, +10.7% YoY; 933 Warehouses Global
items.summary: 好市多2026年7月零售月（截至8月2日的4周）净销售额231.2亿美元，同比增长10.7%；前48周净销售额2735.5亿美元（+10.1%）；全球共933家仓储超市。
items.why: 月度销售数据持续双位数增长显示消费韧性；好市多是消费赛道护城河标的，与山姆竞争持续，卖put策略可在合适行权价布局。
